name: Terror Wing Path
summary: Black dragonflight whelps and dragonkin patrol Terror Wing Path in the eastern Burning Steppes. The rocky canyon is a dangerous route to the region’s remote northeastern corner.

sections.title: A Dragonkin Roost
sections.body: Black dragonflight broods prowl Terror Wing Path’s ash-covered foothills. They guard their clutches and hunt anything that enters the canyon. Ash and soot coat the trails beneath its craggy walls, making the passage treacherous.

sections.title: A Perilous Passage
sections.body: Black drakes patrol the valley, and the rare magma giant Volchan sometimes wanders through. Few adventurers risk the journey alone. This path is the only way to reach Slither Rock, a hidden cave in the far northeastern corner of the Steppes.

faq.q: What creatures live in Terror Wing Path?
faq.answer: Whelps, broodlings, and larger dragonkin of the black dragonflight infest Terror Wing Path. They patrol the slopes and hunt ground prey across the eastern pass.

faq.q: Where does Terror Wing Path lead?
faq.answer: Terror Wing Path winds through the eastern Burning Steppes to the remote northeastern corner. There, the hidden cave of Slither Rock lies.

faq.q: Why is the black dragonflight active in this canyon?
faq.answer: Under Blackrock Mountain, the black dragonflight holds a strong grip over the Burning Steppes. Terror Wing Path gives the flight nesting grounds and hunting terrain. It also guards the mountain’s eastern flanks.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can test your aim against flying whelps and track draconic beasts through the steep canyon terrain.
